sources.scope: Official U.S. 2010 Census surnames occurring at least 100 times, national aggregate (all ages and backgrounds).
Mirror of official Census surname CSV; case normalized for display without adding accents, selected from top 500 recorded surnames.

2,500 next most frequent eligible nationwide 2010 U.S. Census surnames (>=100 occurrences), published as aggregate national counts. Capitalization display-only; do not invent accents. Population counts used solely to select candidate list, not as draw weights.
